name: H-Hour: World's Elite
summary: H-Hour: World's Elite (H-Hour) is a tactical, team-based military shooter in which cooperation among players is required for success. The game uses a third person perspective to enhance the player's situational awareness. Players can see where they are in relation to the world. This battlefield perspective allows for more strategic game play.

name: HHG Megami no Shuuen
summary: This is another telling of Hyper→Highspeed→Genius with a new set of heroines aside from returning protagonist Kyuushirou and heroine Mephisto.

name: hhGregg's Quest for Coupons
summary: hhGregg's Quest for Coupons is a 3D platformer based around the retail store hhGregg. The goal of the game is to collect coupons by completing quests for characters you come across as well as finding them in cleverly hidden places.

name: HHHalloween
summary: Play as a young girl who was sent to an orphanage just a month ago to find the truth about the Halloween demon. The game is a role-playing turn-based RPG. Players need to collect as much candy as possible, talk to passersby as much as possible, and advance the plot.

name: HH Trap: Reality’s Glitch
summary: Join martial artist ''Maika" as she braves a perilous dungeon, only to fall into cunning trap that twists reality. Miss the subtle anomalies and her sharp mind risks transforming into a shameless seductress, lost forever.
